run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the most frequent element in an array using a hash map
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and compare results with f_filled
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts element frequencies and returns the most common element
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary for frequency counting
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty arrays or all unique elements
